description: Least-privilege permissions per Gapsio feature. All permissions are read-only application permissions. Install-Gapsio.ps1, Grant-GapsioPermissions.ps1 and New-GapsioAppRegistrations.ps1 grant exactly the permissions of the selected features – nothing more.

features.name: Endpoint: policies, exclusions, ASR configuration and MDAV baseline from Intune

permissions.why: Intune policies: exclusions, ASR rules, Defender settings (Windows, macOS, Linux)
Display names of the groups policies are assigned to; group and distribution-list search for assignments in the portal
People picker in the portal: assign a finding to an Entra user (name and e-mail only)

features.name: Endpoint: device state, local exclusions, effective ASR mode, Linux/macOS drift, local AI agents (Advanced Hunting)

permissions.why: Advanced Hunting queries (DeviceInfo, TVM, DeviceRegistryEvents, DeviceProcessEvents, AgentsInfo)

features.name: Endpoint: allow indicators from Defender for Endpoint

permissions.why: Read custom indicators (allow/block)

features.name: Endpoint: response readiness – response actions of the last 90 days, investigations waiting for approval, forgotten isolations, untriaged alerts

permissions.why: Read response actions (isolation, live response, investigation package …)
Read alerts with their automated-investigation state

features.name: Endpoint: Defender coverage gaps – Intune-managed devices that are not onboarded to Defender for Endpoint; Intune connector, device risk in compliance and Conditional Access

permissions.why: Compare Intune-managed devices with Defender devices (name, OS, Entra device ID, last sync)
Intune connector for Defender for Endpoint (state, platforms, heartbeat)
Conditional Access policies that require a compliant device (device risk enforcement)

features.name: Endpoint: optional device inventory via Intune Remediations (detection script only)

permissions.why: Results of the Gapsio detection script
Map Intune devices to Defender devices

features.name: Agents: Entra Agent ID, Agent 365 package catalog and Conditional Access coverage

permissions.why: Agent identity blueprints
Blueprint principals in the tenant
Agent identities and their sponsors
Agent users and sponsors (basic profile only)
Agent 365 package catalog (optional, needs the Agent 365 licence)
Legacy Agent 365 registry (optional, retired from May 2026)
Conditional Access policies and security defaults

features.name: Access: Defender XDR unified RBAC – who holds which role (direct, group, PIM eligible, access package), for which data sources, and whether it was ever used; API apps with Defender permissions (credentials, owners), access reviews, PIM activation rules

permissions.why: Defender XDR unified RBAC role definitions and assignments
Entra roles that bypass unified RBAC (Global/Security Administrator, Security Operator/Reader, Global Reader)
PIM for groups: who is eligible for a role-holding group
PIM for groups: when an eligible membership was last activated
Access packages that grant a role-holding group
Sign-ins to the Defender portal – when a permission was last actually used
Resolve role holders of any type (users, groups, service principals)
Which Defender role groups are covered by an access review
PIM for Groups activation rules (MFA, justification, approval, duration) of Defender role groups

features.name: Access: Defender for Endpoint portal activity from the Purview unified audit log (offboarding package downloads, live response, setting changes)

permissions.why: Audit log query API (record type mdatpAudit), last 30 days

features.name: Licensing: Defender for Endpoint licence indication – purchased vs. assigned plans, licensed users, onboarded client devices without a licensed user (needs Hunting for the device mapping)

permissions.why: Subscribed SKUs: purchased and assigned Defender for Endpoint units
Assigned service plans per user (which users hold an MDE P1/P2 or Defender for Business plan)

features.name: Office preview (private preview): telemetry-based Defender for Office 365 view (policy map, anti-phish drift, outcome trends)

permissions.why: Advanced Hunting queries for EmailEvents/UrlClickEvents/CloudAppEvents (MDO telemetry and anti-phish change history)
